versions.changelog:
Initial release of aliyun-cloudauth-verify skill.

- Provides guided workflows for managing Alibaba Cloud ID Verification (Cloudauth) via OpenAPI/SDK.
- Outlines best practices for using environment variables and shared config files for AccessKey.
- Details common API operation patterns (listing, configuration changes, status/troubleshooting).
- Includes quickstart and validation scripts for API discovery and skill setup.
- Defines output and evidence storage policies for reproducibility.
- Lists prerequisites and documentation references.
